description: Everyone’s talking about Claude Design, but here’s a free alternative with no usage limits: Open Design. In this video, I compare the same prompt in both tools and show the difference in the results. You can also create slide decks, videos, audio, and more — plus integrate models like OpenAI ImgGen 2.0 and Seedance. Available free on GitHub. Comment “design” for the link + setup walkthrough.
